headline: Dead Lands And Stlican Shelf Trade Bases Amid Heavy Clashes
war_summary: Since our previous edition, strategic base turnover has reignited in the Dead Lands and Stlican Shelf, while rapid exchanges in Weathered Expanse and Godcrofts have settled into positional grinds. The Dead Lands recorded two fresh base actions in the past two hours, absorbing more than twenty-three hundred combined casualties as fighting surged around Callahan's Boot. Stlican Shelf similarly witnessed three base transitions alongside intense combat, generating nearly twenty-four hundred casualties over the same two-hour interval. In Weathered Expanse, direct base transfers paused during the latest window, yet the sector remains an inferno of attrition with over eighteen hundred casualties logged. Linn of Mercy continues to sustain heavy infantry losses exceeding thirteen hundred casualties in two hours without immediate territorial shifts. Meanwhile, secondary fronts including Godcrofts, Farranac Coast, and King's Cage saw base exchanges taper off after flurry actions earlier in the day, leaving central and eastern sectors as the primary centers of gravity.
